cases.admission: independent client/worker budget/policy/tick/window validation before Release; default legacy cap unchanged
cases.normal: all declared phases follow combined dependency order; actual readiness precedes start completion
cases.duration: dispatch once, complete only after admitted tick duration, within original window
cases.pause: repeated simulation tick does not suspend host health/lease servicing
cases.health: finite cadence and before-dependent probes; failed or missing observation closes starts and tears down
cases.tick_fault: original worker timeout/bad frame/rewind/exhaustion cannot invent ticks or complete steps
cases.evidence: normal M3/public source hashes/Argus schema/flush ACKs; missing records stay missing
cases.teardown: separate scoped stop/cleanup, final reverse cleanup and explicit unresolved child reaping
cases.authority: forged step, registry/handle/session/copy/changed repeat reject; no path/PID adoption
cases.conflict: normal mutation conflicts reject; cancellation does not wait for those locks
cases.leases: original root and individual gates renew separately before expiry; cancellation stays irreversible
